Today, President Donald J. Trump’s Council of Economic Advisers released a report revealing the severe economic cost – $49 TRILLION, over $350,000 per household – for American taxpayers over the next ten years if the Democratic Socialists of America’s top policies were adopted. 

The report titled, “The Real Cost of Socialism in America,” details the scathing reality of their destructive policies:

  • Reopening our borders to millions of criminal illegal immigrants 
  • Handing out amnesty to all illegal aliens in the U.S.
  • Abolishing the police, including ICE
  • Eliminating prisons, which will unleash criminals into American communities 
  • Forcing government-run healthcare for everyone
  • Canceling all student debt for all borrowers

Make no mistake, these are the Democrats’ policies. They want to destroy our great, hard-fought nation, and plummet our economy and the very fabric of our nation into the ground. 

What do those policies really look like? 

  • Everyday costs for Americans skyrocketing with double-digit inflation, soaring up to 160% over ten years;
  • Double-digit interest rates on loans and mortgages for American families at levels not seen in decades, kicking homeownership and the American Dream out of reach
  • Huge tax hikes, cutting hardworking Americans’ paychecks by almost 30% less
  • Millions of Americans’ jobs will be lost, high unemployment, and less pay for the same work

But under President Trump’s leadership, the United States of America will never be a Communist nation. 

In 20 months, President Trump has set the United States back on track and ignited a nationwide renaissance after years of failed Democrat leadership sent our country spiraling into decline. President Trump put money back in your pockets and made our communities safer. America is Back!         

  • President Trump’s Working Families Tax Cuts put money back in Americans’ pockets and saved millions of working Americans over $82 billion with policies such as No Tax on Tips, No Tax on Overtime, No Tax on Social Security, and permanently doubled the enhanced Child Tax Credit. 
  • Inflation is coming down, especially on staple items such as beef, eggs, prescription drugs, motor vehicle insurance, and electricity, after the Democrats’ soaring inflation strangled families’ wallets.
  • President Trump is making the economy work for hardworking Americans again. America’s industries and manufacturing are surging, adding tens of thousands of American manufacturing jobs and increasing manufacturing wages by more than $3,000 from President Trump’s fair trade and pro-growth policies.
  • President Trump added over one million jobs to the American economy in under two years. 
  • America is Energy Dominant again, with oil and gas production records last year, and more abundant and affordable energy on the way to American families. 
  • President Trump’s Ratepayer Protection Pledge ensures hardworking Americans and small businesses aren’t footing the bill for America’s industrial-technological boom, and that their prices come down instead.
  • President Trump put Americans first and ended the Democrat open border crisis, securing the border and deporting over three million illegal immigrants.
  • President Trump made communities safe again with a never-before-seen drop in violent crime, and he is ensuring criminals are put in jail after the Democrats’ war against law enforcement.
  • The Trump Administration is bringing housing industry costs down, home prices are falling across the country, and the supply of homes for sale is at a 10-year high.

Only under President Trump is this reversal possible, and there’s much more to come.

On Day One, President Donald J. Trump promised to “move with purpose and speed to bring back hope, prosperity, safety, and peace.” Nearly two years into his second term, he has done exactly that — delivering results at a pace Washington has never seen.

Here are 32 landmark policy wins from the past few weeks alone:

  • President Trump clawed back nearly $1 billion in wasteful spending aimed at illegal aliens and DEI programs.
  • The Department of State surpassed 250,000 visa revocations, tightening vetting and removing criminal illegal aliens.
  • President Trump launched America.gov, a first-of-its-kind platform putting government services and information directly in Americans’ hands.
  • President Trump secured a $15 billion Iowa steel mill set to add $95 billion to the economy, produce up to 10 million tons of steel per year, and create thousands of permanent jobs.
  • The Department of the Treasury began sending Obamacare refund checks to nearly one million Americans who were overcharged under the Biden Administration.
  • The Department of the Treasury announced that more than 60 million children have been automatically enrolled in Trump Accounts.
  • The Department of the Treasury sanctioned 21 individuals and 25 companies tied to the Sinaloa Cartel.
  • The Department of Education formally rescinded the Biden Administration’s illegal Title IX rewrite.
  • The Department of Energy announced nearly $2 billion for grid upgrades across the country.
  • The Department of Transportation finalized new vehicle efficiency standards that will save Americans nearly $140 billion over five years.
  • The Department of Commerce locked in a $1.6 billion advanced manufacturing investment in Texas.
  • The Department of State secured a historic agreement to develop Nigeria’s $700 billion worth of mineral resources.
  • The Department of State imposed new visa restrictions to combat birth tourism and protect U.S. citizenship.
  • The White House budget office moved to reshore production of 86 essential medicines, including penicillin, epinephrine, and ibuprofen.
  • Federal regulators authorized the Kosciusko Junction pipeline to deliver an extra 1.2 billion cubic feet of natural gas per day to the Southeast.
  • The Department of the Interior completed a Utah oil and gas lease sale that brought in nearly $5 million, with Trump-era revenues already exceeding the entire Biden term.
  • The Departments of Commerce and Energy secured a ten-year LNG supply deal between Lithuania’s Ignitis and U.S. producer EQT.
  • The Department of State facilitated a landmark deal for Biman Bangladesh Airlines to purchase 11 additional Boeing aircraft.
  • The Department of the Treasury expanded tax-payment flexibility for American farmers.
  • The Office of Personnel Management uncovered $500 million in fraud and waste in federal health benefit programs.
  • Medicare officials cancelled 315,000 unauthorized Obamacare enrollments, saving taxpayers roughly $2.2 billion.
  • The Department of Justice charged 17 defendants in a $1.3 million Social Security fraud scheme.
  • The Department of Justice sued the state of Minnesota and the cities of Minneapolis and Saint Paul over a gun scheme that violates the Second Amendment.
  • The EEOC resolved a case against a municipal employer that refused to protect women’s single-sex spaces.
  • Health officials awarded $3 million to develop new ways to cut tick populations and fight Lyme and alpha-gal.
  • The Export-Import Bank secured a $500 million private commitment to build a U.S. Strategic Critical Minerals Reserve.
  • The Department of War unveiled a plan to protect the 2026 midterm elections from foreign interference.
  • The Department of War raised hazard pay for U.S. service members for the first time in over two decades.
  • The Department of War awarded a historic $20.7 billion contract to surge domestic missile production. 
  • The Department of War convened the first Military Spouse Commission meeting at the White House to improve life for military families.
  • The Coast Guard seized more than 260,000 pounds of cocaine under Operation Pacific Viper.
  • The Department of Energy and the Department of War signed an agreement to strengthen joint defenses against drone threats.
  • President Trump’s Memphis Safe Task Force surpassed 13,100 criminal arrests and 2,200 illegal gun seizures, while his D.C. Safe and Beautiful Task Force neared 18,000 arrests and more than 2,100 illegal gun seizures.
  • First Lady Melania Trump secured partnerships with Adobe, Amazon, Intel, Starlink, Google, and Zoom to expand technology and education for children through her Fostering the Future Together initiative.

From reshoring critical industries and cutting waste to crushing crime and protecting taxpayers, President Trump is delivering the agenda Americans elected him to pursue — and he’s not slowing down.

President Trump stands with the American people— no lawmaker, regardless of party or seniority, should utilize insider information for personal profit. In his State of the Union Address to Congress earlier this year, President Trump called for the passage of the Stop Insider Trading Act without delay to ensure that Members of Congress cannot profit from insider information.

“As we ensure that all Americans can profit from a rising stock market, let’s also ensure that members of Congress cannot corruptly profit using inside information… Did Nancy Pelosi stand up? Doubt it. Pass the Stop Insider Trading Act without delay.” – President Trump, State of the Union Address

Yet, today EVERY SENATE DEMOCRAT BLOCKED this legislation to root out corruption in Washington and ban Members of Congress, their spouses, and their dependent children from purchasing individual stocks from publicly traded companies. Members of Congress shouldn’t be buying individual stocks while writing laws and making decisions that directly move financial markets. This is commonsense.

Republicans and President Trump are UNITED behind the Stop Insider Trading Act – critical legislation that would deliver the most significant change to stock trading rules in over a decade after President Obama’s STOCK Act failed to hold members accountable. Look no further than Nancy Pelosi as proof that a stock trading ban is necessary to stop corruption at the highest levels and restore the public’s trust.

When lawmakers consistently outperform stock trading benchmarks, Americans are rightly asking questions and demanding transparency. Democrats are now on the record opposing this commonsense legislation that nearly 90% of Americans support.

In July, House Democrats voted almost unanimously against advancing this legislation.

This legislation also included a commonsense provision that would require voters to provide a photo ID to vote to ensure that only American citizens vote in American elections— a measure that is vastly supported by the American people.

President Donald J. Trump announced a $15 billion Mesabi Metallics steel complex is coming to Iowa — the largest steel plant ever built in the United States as more industrial capacity comes home. The project will create 1,750 new, permanent jobs, support up to 6,000 construction jobs, and generate an estimated $95 billion in U.S. economic output over construction and the first decade of operations.

Iowa leaders are heralding the “transformational” investment:

Iowa Gov. Kim Reynolds: “I want to thank President Trump for his commitment to bringing steel manufacturing back to America, and Mesabi Metallics for choosing Iowa as its partner and future home. This is a transformational opportunity for our country, our state, and American families—one that strengthens national security, creates thousands of high-paying jobs, and provides a reliable supply of high-quality, American-made steel for strategic goods and everyday products. Our commitment in Iowa to fiscal responsibility, tax competitiveness, and long-term economic stability has created one of the nation’s strongest environments for business investment. Now, this opportunity will fundamentally change the economic trajectory of our state and the entire region for decades to come.”

Iowa Attorney General Brenna Bird: “This massive investment is the largest steel plant project in U.S. History. It means over 1,750 good-paying, family-supporting, steel working jobs for Southeast Iowa. This announcement is not just good news for Iowa, it’s good for the entire country. Thanks to President Trump for his leadership and continued commitment to American jobs for American citizens and to Governor Reynolds for her hard work bringing this great opportunity to Iowa.”

Sen. Chuck Grassley: “GR8 NEWS Mesabi Metallics will build a $15 BILLION steel mill in IA Remember GOP is working 2 bring down costs 4 families + create jobs This historic investment is AMERICA FIRST+builds on success of our Working Families Tax Cuts law which also prevented largest tax increase ever”

Sen. Joni Ernst: “Proud to join @POTUS today announcing a historic $15 BILLION investment in eastern Iowa, the largest steel plant in American history, and over 1700 permanent jobs in Iowa! Thank you, President Trump, for bringing jobs, investment, and American manufacturing back home!”

Rep. Mariannette Miller-Meeks: “For too long, Iowa families have watched their jobs shipped overseas and their communities hollowed out. Not anymore. The largest steel plant in America is coming to Lee County with more than 1,700 permanent, good-paying jobs. I’m proud to have helped make this historic investment a reality. There’s no better place than Iowa to make things IN America, BY Americans.”

Rep. Ashley Hinson: “This will be a game-changing investment for our state — creating 1,700 jobs & incredible opportunities for growth. There is no better place to invest and build than in Iowa because we have the best people.”

Rep. Zach Nunn: “This is a major opportunity for Southeast Iowa: Mesabi Metallics’ proposed $15 billion investment in Lee County could support 1,700 good-paying jobs and produce American steel right here in Iowa. We’ve worked to bring manufacturing home and secured nearly $5 million to strengthen skilled trades training at DMACC, Iowa Western, and Indian Hills. Now, we need to make sure Iowa workers have the skills to be first in line for these jobs and ready to build the next generation of American steel.”

Iowa Congressional Delegation: “This historic investment is a major win for Iowa workers and further cements Iowa’s role in the future of American manufacturing. As the largest steel plant investment in U.S. history, this project will generate over 1,700 good-paying Iowa jobs, create new opportunities for Iowa families, and drive economic growth. Iowa has the workforce, work ethic, resources, and business climate to compete with anyone, and we are proud to welcome this project to our state. The administration’s pro-American manufacturing policies are incentivizing companies to invest, build, and create jobs in the U.S. We thank Governor Reynolds for her leadership in making Iowa a great place to do business and ensuring our state benefits from these policies by attracting transformational investments like this one.”

Iowa Speaker of the House Pat Grassley: “This project would be a gamechanger for southeast Iowa and leave a lasting impact on our state’s manufacturing footprint. This will bring real jobs that mean stable careers for working families, giving more young people a chance to proudly call Iowa home. I’ve made it my mission in the Iowa House to make sure we bring opportunities for growth to all parts of the state and delivering this plant follows through on that promise.”

Iowa Senate Majority Leader Mike Klimesh: “For years, we have been passing legislation to help Iowa grow, draw people to our rural communities, and strengthen our state’s economy. Iowa has an opportunity to bring billions of dollars of investment into our state, good quality jobs, and bring people to a part of Iowa looking for growth. These are the kinds of opportunities we have been looking for and that Iowa needs. As we look to remain competitive on the national level, the largest private investment in Iowa history makes it clear our state is open for business.”

Iowa State Rep. Carter Nordman: “$15 BILLION dollar investment in Iowa (largest ever, by far)! Thank you President Donald J. Trump & Governor Kim Reynolds for your leadership on this historic project!”

Iowa State Rep. Austin Harris: “HUGE day for Iowa! The President is announcing a $15 billion investment to build America’s largest steel mill right here in our state — more than 1,750 good-paying jobs for Iowa families. This didn’t happen by accident. For years, Iowa has done the hard work of cutting taxes, slashing red tape, and making it cheaper and faster to build here than almost anywhere else in the country. Companies don’t drop $15 billion on a handshake. They go where the rules are clear, the tax climate is competitive, and the workforce can get the job done. That’s Iowa. We made ourselves the place they wanted to be. Now it will pay off in paychecks, apprenticeships, suppliers, and communities that will feel this for a generation. I am proud of this state and proud of the workers who are about to make history. Iowa is open for business! Let’s get to work!”

Iowa State Rep. Blaine Watkins: “To have one of the largest steel plants in American history built right here in Lee County would be a huge win for our area. It would mean thousands of high-paying, dependable jobs that would give young Iowans a reason to stay, grow their families, and thrive right here in Southeast Iowa. I’ve been fighting for this kind of opportunity in the Iowa House, and I will fight to get this project over the finish line in the Iowa House.”

Iowa State Rep. Matt Rinker: “As a Burlington native, I recognize this announcement for what it is: a once-in-a-generation economic development victory for Iowa. Since being elected to the Iowa House, my priorities have included securing high-paying careers to ensure more people can call Iowa home, and keeping our state competitive in manufacturing apprenticeships and training. The announcement of one of the largest steel plants in American history built right here in Iowa shows that the work we’ve done at the Statehouse, including reducing the tax burden and keeping government spending fiscally responsible is working. In the House, I will fight to deliver this opportunity for my district.”

Lee County (IA) Economic Development Group President and CEO Emily Benjamin: “Today is a great day for eastern Iowa. A $15 billion investment with more than 6,000 construction jobs and 1,750 permanent jobs would be transformational for our region, and we congratulate Mesabi Metallics on today’s announcement.”

Burlington (IA) Mayor Jon Billups: “What’s great for the southeast Iowa region is great for Burlington and what’s great for Burlington is great for southeast Iowa.”

Former Iowa Gov. Terry Branstad: “Steel mill will deliver overwhelming benefits to Iowa”

Mesabi Metallics Chairman Rewant Ruia: “Thank you, Mr. President, for bringing back the importance of building things in America. With the new steel complex in Iowa, we will complete the fully integrated American supply chain from mine to mill. American ore carried on American railroads to an American steel plant powered by American energy, built and operated by an incredibly hardworking and talented American workforce.”

Mesabi Metallics CEO Joe Broking: “This is a major moment for U.S. made steel, combining the highest quality direct-reduction grade iron ore pellet from Minnesota’s Iron Range with the most advanced DRI to EAF steelmaking technology in Iowa to supply the high-quality, all-American steel that our national defense, cars and trucks, shipbuilding, household appliances, energy, and infrastructure depend on.”

Export-Import Bank of the United States Chairman John Jovanovic: “What we’re really talking about today is America’s economic security… What you see here today is private capital flowing in to rebuild America and to build America’s future.”

American Iron and Steel Institute President and CEO Kevin Dempsey: “President Trump’s Section 232 steel tariffs continue to energize the American iron and steel industry. AISI welcomes today’s announcement of another significant new investment in steelmaking in the United States. The sizeable investment by Mesabi Metallics in the new Iowa plant and also its Nashwauk, Minnesota, iron ore mine will further boost U.S. ironmaking and steelmaking capacity, create jobs and strengthen the U.S. economy.”

The Boyd Company Principal John Boyd: “This is coming to Lee County, an area in Iowa really in dire need of revitalization. This is the right project at the right time.”

America First Policy Institute: “President Trump announces a historic $15 BILLION steel plant coming to Iowa — the largest in American history. 6,000 construction jobs. Nearly 2,000 permanent jobs. 10 MILLION tons of American steel produced every year. American steel is BACK.”

First Lady Melania Trump secured six new private-sector technology partnerships for Fostering the Future Together, including Adobe, Amazon, Intel, Starlink, Google, and Zoom.

“When I established Fostering the Future Together, the mission was clear: empower children through technology and education. Delivering on that mission demands alliances between best-in-class innovators and global leaders, especially as super intelligence transforms how the next generation learns,” said First Lady Melania Trump.

Combined, the new technology partners committed more than $23 million towards education, tools, and expertise, for children across the globe.

Google committed $4 million to expand its SI Educator Series globally through its new Fostering the Future Together partnership. “Google is proud to support First Lady Melania Trump’s vital effort,” said Google’s Maggie Johnson. “This investment demonstrates our belief in keeping educators in the lead.”

Intel will deploy its technology across ten countries through its SI for Citizens Program, SI for Youth Program, and Semiconductor Education Pathways Program. Adobe will provide students worldwide with free SI-powered study and creation tools through Student Spaces. Amazon will expand free access to its Kiro SI coding assistant, reaching 5 million students through 132 universities, while AWS Academy will provide free training to more than 2 million students. Zoom Cares will provide $2.75 million in SI for Good grants across Europe, Africa, Latin America, and the Asia-Pacific region.

“I deeply value the commitment of these technology companies and welcome them to the Fostering the Future Together movement as we scale across continents,” said First Lady Melania Trump.

About Fostering the Future Together:
Fostering the Future Together is a global coalition of nations unified to empower children through technology and education.

First Lady Melania Trump announced Fostering the Future Together during the 80th United Nations General Assembly. In spring 2026, she convened the initiative’s two-day meeting in Washington DC, bringing together First Spouses and technology-sector leaders at the United Sates Department of State. The gathering culminated at the White House, where the First Lady welcomed the largest assembly of First Spouses ever convened there for diplomatic purposes in U.S. history. During the 81st United Nations General Assembly, First Lady Melania Trump unveiled several new 2026 Fostering the Future Together regional events, including the G20 (USA), the ASEAN Conference (Philippines), Europe (Poland), and the Caribbean (Saint Kitts and Nevis).

ELIMINATING INVASIVE TICKS AND MOSQUITOES: Today, President Donald J. Trump signed an Executive Order to eliminate invasive ticks and mosquitoes in the Federal jurisdiction of Washington, D.C. through safe and effective, non-chemical, and technology-enabled methods, and invest in pioneering approaches to eliminate these pests throughout the country.

  • The Order directs the Secretary of the Interior, the Secretary of Agriculture, the Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency, and the Administrator of General Services, along with the Secretary of Health and Human Services, to develop and implement a campaign across Washington, D.C. to reduce invasive mosquito populations by 90 percent and the tick population by 50 percent by 2028 using safe and effective, non-chemical, and innovative technology-enabled methods. 
    • The campaign should remediate tick and mosquito breeding grounds on lands subject to Federal jurisdiction throughout D.C. using commonsense and technical approaches.
    • The campaign will also prioritize the use of commercial capabilities or cooperative agreements to reduce the population of disease-carrying pests in D.C.
  • The Order directs the Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency, with the Secretary of Agriculture and the Secretary of Health and Human Services, to submit a regulatory framework for the planned development and release of advanced, safe, and effective tick and mosquito control technologies.
  • The Order directs the Secretary of Health and Human Services to build on the existing Lyme Disease Moonshot initiative through prize competition announcements and additional research and development programs to prevent and treat tick- and mosquito-borne diseases.
  • The Order also directs the Secretary of Agriculture, the Secretary of the Interior, the Secretary of Health and Human Services, and the Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency to issue additional prize competition announcements or direct research programs for the development of non-chemical means to reduce tick- and mosquito-borne diseases.
  • The Order directs the Secretary of Agriculture and the Secretary of Health and Human Services to explore options for labeling food and drug products that include significant amounts of alpha-galactose, similar to other allergy warnings.


SAFEGUARDING AMERICANS’ HEALTH AND DEMONSTRATING INNOVATIVE PEST CONTROL: President Trump is addressing the invasive tick and mosquito populations that spread debilitating diseases across America. 

  • Foreign, invasive mosquitoes are multiplying across the United States and have become the dominant species in some areas, including Washington, D.C.—spreading disease and diminishing quality of life.
    • The expanding tick populations in the country expose Americans, our pets, and our livestock to debilitating and expensive health risks.  
  • The use of commonsense, non-chemical, technology-enabled measures can significantly reduce the negative effects of these pests, enhancing enjoyment of the great outdoors for all Americans.
  • Alpha-gal syndrome, a serious allergy to red meat that can develop after a tick bite, is increasingly common in America due to the spread of ticks to new areas of the United States.  
  • This new model, localized to Washington, D.C., can later be applied nationwide as targeted, innovative, non-chemical pest control for the whole nation.
  • Americans should be able to enjoy the beauty and health of Our Nation’s Capital without the threat of widespread invasive ticks and mosquito populations. President Trump is Making D.C. Safe and Beautiful Again.

MAKING AMERICA HEALTHY, SAFE, AND BEAUTIFUL: President Trump is committed to Making America Healthy Again and leading the world in Gold Standard Science, with multiple initiatives emanating out of Washington, D.C. 

  • In February 2025, President Trump created the Make America Healthy Again Commission to tackle the rise of chronic illness.
  • In March 2025, President Trump established the Make D.C. Safe and Beautiful Task Force to make Washington, D.C. what it should be—the pride of every American to whom it belongs. In August 2025, the President declared a crime emergency in Washington, D.C. 
    • Just over a year later, thousands of criminals have been removed from the streets, homeless encampments are cleared, parks are reclaimed, and crime has plummeted.
    • This model has been replicated across the country in cities such as Memphis, TN, and violent crime nationwide is down to historic lows not seen in decades.
  • In July 2025, President Trump signed an Executive Order establishing the Make America Beautiful Again (MABA) Commission to ensure that our Nation’s next 250 years are beautiful, successful, and secure. 
  • President Trump signed multiple Executive Orders that improved the safety and security of biological research, ended dangerous gain-of-function research, restored Gold Standard Science as the cornerstone of Federal scientific research, and rebuilt public trust in science.

By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and the laws of the United States of America, it is hereby ordered:

Section 1.  Background and Purpose.  Ticks and mosquitoes are among the deadliest animals worldwide, transmitting major diseases that impose growing health and economic burdens on the American public.  Foreign, invasive mosquitoes, especially the Asian tiger and Egyptian mosquitoes, are multiplying across the United States and have become the dominant species in some areas, including the District of Columbia (D.C.), spreading disease and diminishing quality of life.  Furthermore, the expanding tick populations in the United States expose Americans, our pets, and our livestock to debilitating and expensive health risks.  Historical approaches have relied primarily on the use of conventional pesticides; however, the use of commonsense, non-chemical, technology-enabled measures can significantly reduce the negative effects of these pests, enhancing enjoyment of the great outdoors for all Americans.

Sec. 2.  Policy.  It is the policy of the United States to develop and deploy commonsense approaches and technological capabilities to suppress tick and mosquito populations and address the harms these insects cause, using improved detection, screening, prevention, and health care interventions.  These goals will be achieved through the following policy priorities:

(a)  Leading the world in safe and effective tick and mosquito population control to prevent disease through smart land management techniques and procedures, natural predator populations, non-chemical pest control measures, and advanced technologies, including sterile insect techniques and insect control tools developed with safe and effective biotechnologies.

(b)  Diagnosing, preventing, and treating the syndromes and diseases spread by ticks and mosquitoes in the United States, including alpha-gal syndrome, Theileriosis, Rocky Mountain spotted fever, Lyme disease, and Babesiosis (spread by ticks), and viral infections such as West Nile, Zika, Chikungunya, and Dengue fever (spread by mosquitoes).

(c)  Advancing the objectives of the D.C. Safe and Beautiful Task Force set forth in Executive Order 14252 of March 27, 2025 (Making the District of Columbia Safe and Beautiful), by reducing the invasive tick and mosquito populations across D.C. both safely and effectively, without negative effects on beneficial insects, native plants and animals, or the natural beauty of our parks, waterways, and recreational areas.

(d)  Expanding the successful techniques and approaches developed in section 3 of this order as a model for nationwide control of tick and invasive mosquito populations.

Sec. 3.  Implementation.  (a)  Within 60 days of the date of this order, the Secretary of the Interior, the Secretary of Agriculture, the Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency, and the Administrator of General Services, in consultation with the Secretary of Health and Human Services, shall develop and implement a campaign across D.C. to, by 2028, reduce the Asian tiger mosquito, Egyptian mosquito, and other invasive mosquito populations, as appropriate, by 90 percent and reduce the tick population by 50 percent, with further reductions as practicable.  The campaign shall:

(i)    remediate tick and mosquito breeding grounds on lands subject to Federal jurisdiction throughout D.C., including by reducing tick and mosquito habitats through landscaping and drainage improvements, e.g., mowing and rain gardens, and strategic deployment of natural, targeted controls;

(ii)   control pest transport and key host reservoir or amplification populations, including rodents and deer, that facilitate ticks and tickborne diseases;

(iii)  prioritize the use of commercial capabilities or cooperative agreements, including the deployment of advanced technological solutions such as sterile insect techniques for mosquitoes or other safe and effective biotechnologies; and

(iv)   include a plan, developed in consultation with the Government of D.C., as appropriate, for implementing tick and mosquito controls on lands across D.C. communities.

(b)  Within 60 days of the date of this order, to expedite the campaign ordered in subsection 3(a) of this order, the Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency, in consultation with the Secretary of Agriculture and the Secretary of Health and Human Services, shall:

(i)   submit to the President, through the Assistant to the President and Homeland Security Advisor, a regulatory framework, informed by relevant academic centers and industry, for the planned development and release into the environment of advanced, safe, and effective tick and mosquito control technologies.  This framework shall consider sterilization techniques, safe genetic modification, and use of safe, beneficial bacteria, in alignment with Executive Order 14292 of May 5, 2025 (Improving the Safety and Security of Biological Research); and

(ii)  prioritize and expeditiously advance or register novel tick and mosquito control methods or products that the Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency finds to be both safe and effective.

(c)  Within 90 days of the date of this order, the Secretary of Health and Human Services, building on the Lyme Disease Moonshot initiative already underway, as appropriate, shall:

(i)   issue prize competition announcements under 15 U.S.C. 3719 or other applicable laws, or direct research and development programs for rapid diagnostics to identify, prophylactics to prevent — and therapeutics to treat — tick- and mosquito-borne diseases of consequence as determined by the head of the agency, including those listed in subsection 2(b) of this order; and

(ii)  review available and candidate immunotherapy treatments for alpha-gal syndrome and develop a research agenda to accelerate the clinical review of viable candidates.

(d)  Within 90 days of the date of this order, the Secretary of Agriculture, in coordination with the Secretary of the Interior, the Secretary of Health and Human Services, and the Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency, shall issue prize competition announcements under 15 U.S.C. 3719 or other applicable laws, or direct research programs, for the development of non-chemical means to reduce tick- and mosquito‑borne diseases of consequence, including through reducing tick and mosquito populations.

(e)  Within 60 days of the date of this order, the Secretary of Agriculture and the Secretary of Health and Human Services, as appropriate, shall explore options for labeling food and drug products that include significant amounts of alpha-galactose, in a manner similar to other allergy warnings.

(f)  The Secretary of the Interior, the Secretary of Agriculture, the Secretary of Health and Human Services, and the heads of other relevant agencies, in coordination with the Director of the Office of Management and Budget, shall review available resources to support the implementation of this order.

Sec. 4.  General Provisions.  (a)  Nothing in this order shall be construed to impair or otherwise affect:

(i)   the authority granted by law to an executive department or agency, or the head thereof; or

(ii)  the functions of the Director of the Office of Management and Budget relating to budgetary, administrative, or legislative proposals.

(b)  This order shall be implemented consistent with applicable law and subject to the availability of appropriations.

(c)  This order is not intended to, and does not, create any right or benefit, substantive or procedural, enforceable at law or in equity by any party against the United States, its departments, agencies, or entities, its officers, employees, or agents, or any other person.

(d)  The costs for publication of this order shall be borne by the Department of the Interior.

                            

DONALD J. TRUMP

THE WHITE HOUSE,

    September 29, 2026.

USHERING IN SUPER INTELLIGENCE: Today, President Donald J. Trump signed an Executive Order to replace the term “Artificial Intelligence” (“AI”) with “Super Intelligence” (“SI”) in the executive branch to recognize the continuously advancing technological frontier and the limitless promise it offers the American people.

  • The Order directs all departments and agencies to use the terms “Super Intelligence” and “SI” in official correspondence, public communications, policy documents, and non-statutory documents within the executive branch and to no longer acknowledge the terms “Artificial Intelligence” or “AI”.
  • The Order directs the Assistant to the President for Science and Technology (APST) to propose a Federal definition of “Super Intelligence” and “SI” that reflects the state of this extraordinary frontier technology and identify any additional executive action necessary to implement the proposed definition.

RECOGNIZING THE IMMENSE OPPORTUNITY OF SI: The United States is the world leader in Super Intelligence, and the Federal government should use a name that reflects the full promise and opportunity of these technologies.

  • The United States is the birthplace of Artificial Intelligence and is pushing this frontier forward, having led the world in its development and deployment for over 70 years since its inception as a field of research.
  • The name Super Intelligence conveys the true capabilities of the technologies being developed today, unlocking new forms of human creativity and empowering Americans to achieve what was previously impossible—not simply imitating or automating human intelligence as is implied by the term “Artificial Intelligence.”
  • Using the name Super Intelligence will ensure departments and agencies remain focused on expanding the capabilities and applications of these technologies to empower Americans, strengthen our economy, and improve the lives of the American people.

ADVANCING THE FRONTIER OF AMERICAN INNOVATION: President Trump has taken decisive action to ensure that the United States leads and wins in Super Intelligence, and that all Americans benefit from Super Intelligence and its vast economic benefits. 

  • Immediately upon returning to office, President Trump eliminated the Biden Administration’s overreaching and harmful SI policies, unleashing a new era of innovation. 
  • Under President Trump’s leadership, the Federal Government has announced more than $5 billion for the Genesis Mission, a national effort to harness Super Intelligence to accelerate breakthroughs in science, medicine, energy, and manufacturing.
  • In July 2025, the White House released America’s AI Action Plan, identifying more than 90 Federal actions to win the SI race by accelerating SI innovation, building American SI infrastructure, and extending U.S. SI leadership around the world.
  • In March 2026, the White House unveiled a commonsense, comprehensive National Super Intelligence Policy Framework with legislative recommendations to ensure that every American benefits from this technological revolution.

By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and the laws of the United States of America, it is hereby ordered:

Section 1.  Purpose.  America stands at the forefront of a new technological revolution in intelligence.  The modern field of artificial intelligence was born in the United States, where American scientists first gave the field its name and laid the foundations for its development.  Seventy years later, powered by our Nation’s unmatched culture of innovation, world-leading companies and research institutions, and entrepreneurial spirit, America is once again pushing the technological frontier forward.

The extraordinary technologies being pioneered by American innovators far exceed what was envisioned when the term “Artificial Intelligence” first came into use.  The capabilities of today’s frontier systems do much more than imitate or automate discrete aspects of human intelligence.  They increasingly amplify human ingenuity and unlock new forms of creativity, empowering Americans to achieve what was previously impossible across science, medicine, and nearly every other domain of human endeavor.  As these capabilities continue to improve, they increasingly represent not merely artificial intelligence, but a new era of Super Intelligence.

The terminology used by the Federal Government should reflect the transformative capabilities of these technologies and the limitless opportunities they create for the American people.  Accordingly, the term “Super Intelligence” more appropriately captures the promise, potential, and rapidly advancing capabilities of these technologies.  It is therefore the policy of my Administration that, to the maximum extent permitted by law, the executive branch shall use the terms “Super Intelligence” and “SI” in place of “Artificial Intelligence” and “AI” and will not acknowledge the usage of “Artificial Intelligence” and “AI” in any applicable setting.

Sec. 2.  Implementation.  (a)  To the maximum extent permitted by law, executive departments and agencies (agencies) shall use “Super Intelligence” and “SI” in place of “Artificial Intelligence” and “AI” in official correspondence, public communications, websites, reports, policy documents, and other non-statutory documents within the executive branch.

(b)  Nothing in this section requires the alteration of previously issued regulations, Presidential actions, contracts, grants, or other historical documents.

Sec. 3.  Definition.  (a)  For purposes of this order, and except where otherwise provided by law, the terms “Super Intelligence” and “SI” mean the technologies and systems encompassed by the term “artificial intelligence” as defined in section 9401(3) of title 15, United States Code.  This definition shall govern the implementation of this order unless and until superseded by subsequent Presidential action consistent with applicable law or by an Act of Congress.

(b)  Within 60 days of the date of this order, the Assistant to the President for Science and Technology (APST), in consultation with the heads of other agencies as the APST deems appropriate, shall submit to the President proposed legislative language to establish a Federal definition of “Super Intelligence” and “SI” that reflects the capabilities described in section 1 of this order.  The proposal shall include:

(i)    an assessment of whether, and to what extent, the definition of “Super Intelligence” and “SI” should modify, expand upon, or otherwise supersede the existing statutory definition of “artificial intelligence”;

(ii)   any proposed conforming amendments, as appropriate, to existing statutory references to “artificial intelligence” and “AI”; and

(iii)  recommendations for any additional Presidential or executive action necessary to implement the proposed definition throughout the executive branch.

Sec. 4.  General Provisions.  (a)  Nothing in this order shall be construed to impair or otherwise affect:

(i)   the authority granted by law to an executive department or agency, or the head thereof; or

(ii)  the functions of the Director of the Office of Management and Budget relating to budgetary, administrative, or legislative proposals.

(b)  This order shall be implemented consistent with applicable law and subject to the availability of appropriations.

(c)  This order is not intended to, and does not, create any right or benefit, substantive or procedural, enforceable at law or in equity by any party against the United States, its departments, agencies, or entities, its officers, employees, or agents, or any other person.

(d)  The costs for publication of this order shall be borne by the Office of Science and Technology Policy.

                              

DONALD J. TRUMP

THE WHITE HOUSE,     September 29, 2026.

The White House will welcome visitors this fall for the 2026 Fall Garden Tours, offering an opportunity for visitors to experience the historic gardens and grounds of the People’s House. The grounds will be open Saturday, October 17 from 10:00 AM – 4:30 PM, and Sunday, October 18 from 10:00 AM – 2:30 PM.

Throughout the tour, guests will enjoy the beauty of the South Lawn, the Rose Garden, the White House Kitchen Garden, the expanded White House Beehive, and the new helipad. Rich in history and tradition, the White House gardens provide guests with a unique glimpse into the grounds that have served as a backdrop throughout our nation’s 250 years of history.

This event is free and open to the public. A ticket is required for all attendees, including small children. The National Park Service will distribute free, timed tickets at a tent outside the White House Visitor Center each day of the tours beginning at 8:30 AM. The White House Visitor Center is located at 1450 Pennsylvania Avenue NW, Washington, DC, 20004, near the intersection of 15th Street and E Street Northwest.

Tickets will be distributed—one ticket per person—on a first-come, first-served basis.

Please note the following items are not allowed on the White House grounds:

  • Aerosols
  • Ammunition
  • Animals other than service/guide animals
  • Backpacks and bags exceeding size restrictions (18” x 13” x 7”)
  • Bicycles and scooters
  • Drones and other unmanned aircraft systems
  • E-cigarettes
  • Electronic tablets
  • Explosives
  • Firearms
  • Glass, thermal, or metal containers
  • Laser pointers
  • Lighters
  • Mace/pepper spray
  • Metal water bottles
  • Packages
  • Rangefinders
  • Selfie sticks
  • Signs and flags of any kind
  • Structures
  • Supports for signs and placards
  • Toy guns
  • Umbrellas with metal tips
  • Weapons of any kind
  • Wearable technology capable of photo or video
  • Any other items determined to be potential safety hazard

The Secret Service reserves the right to prohibit any other personal items. However, strollers, wheelchairs, umbrellas (no metal tips), and cameras are permitted. All items needed for medical purposes will be permitted on the tour (such as wheelchairs, electric scooters, glucose tablets, and EpiPens). Please identify and explain all items needed for medical purposes to Secret Service personnel upon arrival.

In the event of inclement weather, the event may be canceled. Please call the 24-hour information line at (202) 456-7040 to check on the status of the event. For more information, including what visitors will need to access the White House campus, please visit www.WhiteHouse.gov/Visit.

By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and the laws of the United States of America, it is hereby ordered:

Section 1.  Purpose.  For generations, Americans seeking essential services from the Federal Government have been required to navigate a system organized around the structure of Government rather than the needs of the people.  Americans must search across numerous executive departments and agency (agency) websites, interpret complicated Government terminology, frequently provide the same information, and repeatedly prove their identities to a Government that may already possess the information necessary to serve them.  The American people deserve better.

Advances in technology now make possible a fundamentally different relationship between the people and the Federal Government, defined by simplicity, speed, accuracy, security, and respect for the individual.  The same spirit of American innovation that can accelerate scientific discovery can also help Americans complete essential interactions with the Federal Government.

This order therefore directs the establishment of America.gov as the unified digital front door to the Federal Government for every individual in the United States seeking Federal information or services.  America.gov will not be merely another website, search engine, or directory of Government links.  It will be a secure, intelligent, and service-oriented point of entry through which an individual may sign in, communicate in plain language, receive accurate answers, and, where authorized and technically available, complete Government transactions without being required to navigate the websites of multiple agencies.  America.gov will enable the Federal Government to do its own paperwork so that the American people may get on with their lives.

Sec. 2.  Policy.  It is the policy of the United States to:

(a)  provide every individual in the United States seeking Federal information or services with a single, secure, conversational point of entry through which the citizen may discover, access, and, where authorized, complete covered Federal transactions;

(b)  establish common standards of quality, simplicity, accessibility, interoperability, security, reliability, and design across participating Federal digital services and public-facing websites;

(c)  preserve each agency’s custody and control of its records, systems, statutory responsibilities, and adjudicatory authority and ensure that unifying access to Federal services does not create a centralized Federal system of records concerning the American people;

(d)  protect personal information through data minimization, secure authentication, auditable authorization, and disclosure practices consistent with applicable law;

(e)  ensure that super intelligence used in connection with America.gov is accurate, reliable, and transparent; and

(f)  preserve existing lawful methods by which Americans may obtain Federal services, including in-person, telephone, mail, and agency-specific digital services, so that America.gov provides a better option but does not become the only option.

Sec. 3.  Definition.  The term “covered services” means public-facing Federal services that serve more than 100,000 users in a 12-month period and can be accessed or applied for online. The term excludes tax filing services provided by the Internal Revenue Service and services provided by the Department of War and elements of the Intelligence Community.  The Director of the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) may, by memorandum, add or exclude “covered services.”

Sec. 4.  Establishing America.gov.  The Administrator of General Services, in coordination with the Administrator of the National Design Studio and the Director of OMB, shall:

(a) establish and operate America.gov as the single point of entry for Americans to access covered services online; and

(b) take such steps as are necessary to integrate Login.gov with America.gov, including using Login.gov as the authentication service for America.gov.

Sec. 5.  Implementing America.gov.  (a)  Within 90 days of the date of this order, the Director of OMB shall issue a memorandum to the heads of agencies on implementation of this order.

(b)  Heads of agencies shall:

(i)    identify covered services in their respective agencies;

(ii)   integrate the provisions of such services with America.gov in a secure and privacy-preserving manner, including by making the public Application Programming Interfaces, dashboards, and digital forms that already support services accessible through the America.gov platform;

(iii)  complete integration with Login.gov consistent with the requirements of section 1523(b)(1)(D) of title 6, United States Code, and OMB Memorandum M-26-18; and

(iv)   provide, on an ongoing basis, the Administrator of General Services and the Director of OMB with historical and current usage and performance data for covered services.

Sec. 6.  General Provisions.  (a)  Nothing in this order shall be construed to impair or otherwise affect:

(i)   the authority granted by law to an executive department or agency, or the head thereof; or

(ii)  the functions of the Director of the Office of Management and Budget relating to budgetary, administrative, or legislative proposals.

(b)  This order shall be implemented consistent with applicable law and subject to the availability of appropriations.

(c)  This order is not intended to, and does not, create any right or benefit, substantive or procedural, enforceable at law or in equity by any party against the United States, its departments, agencies, or entities, its officers, employees, or agents, or any other person.

(d)  Nothing in this order shall be construed to require the disclosure of information that is prohibited by law, or to authorize any person other than the originating agency to access records maintained by that agency about an individual, except as provided by the Privacy Act of 1974 (5 U.S.C. 552a) or other applicable law.

(e)  The costs for publication of this order shall be borne by the General Services Administration.

                             DONALD J. TRUMP

THE WHITE HOUSE,

    September 29, 2026.

REDESIGNING GOVERNMENT SERVICES FOR AMERICANS: Today, President Donald J. Trump launched America.gov, a single digital point of entry for Americans to access Federal government information or services online, and signed an Executive Order to ensure Federal agencies integrate with America.gov.

  • America.gov is a secure, intelligent, and service-oriented single point of entry through which an individual can sign in, communicate in plain language, receive accurate answers, and, where authorized and technically available, complete government transactions without having to navigate multiple Federal agencies’ websites.
    • America.gov implements modern technology and Super Intelligence (SI) to dramatically improve how the Federal government serves Americans, all while preserving personal privacy.
    • Right now, Americans can ask any question on America.gov and get an up-to-date answer. Later this year, Americans will be able to complete tasks like passport renewal and Medicare enrollment on America.gov, without being sent back into a maze of websites. More services will be roll out onto America.gov as agencies integrate with it. 
  • The Order directs the Administrator of General Services, the Administrator of the National Design Studio, and the Director of the Office of Management and Budget to establish and operate America.gov as the single point of entry for Americans to access covered services online, and to integrate Login.gov with America.gov.
    • Covered services include public-facing Federal services that serve more than 100,000 users in a 12-month period and can be accessed or applied for online. Tax filing services provided by the Internal Revenue Service and national-security-sensitive services provided by the Department of War and the Intelligence Community are excluded.
  • The Order directs the Director of the Office of Management and Budget to issue guidance to executive agencies to ensure they implement their covered services into America.gov. 

MODERNIZING HOW GOVERNMENT WORKS FOR AMERICANS: The Trump Administration is making it easier and more accessible for you and your family to find answers and get things done within the Federal government.  

  • For generations, Americans seeking essential services from the Federal government have spent hours of their time navigating systems organized around the Federal bureaucracy rather than the needs of the people.
    • Americans spend around 10 billion hours each year dealing with federal paperwork. The American people deserve better.
  • Federal services should work the way you do, not against you.  America.gov gives power back to the people, returns Americans’ time, and restores the respect and the dignity they deserve from their government. 
  • American innovation and modern technology allow the Federal government to use simplicity, speed, accuracy, and security to help Americans complete essential interactions with the Federal government. 


REFORMING GOVERNMENT TO WORK FOR YOU: President Trump has consistently prioritized innovation and efficiency, ensuring that Federal programs are efficient, transparent, and focused on delivering real value to taxpayers—making government smaller, smarter, and work for the American people.

  • President Trump has driven sweeping reforms to eliminate waste, reduce bureaucracy, and restore accountability across the Federal government. 
  • Under the Trump Administration, the backlog of veterans waiting for benefits has dropped by 74%, demonstrating the Trump Administration’s dedication to making government efficient and responsive to those it serves.
  • Vice President Vance’s Fraud Task Force has uncovered over $260 billion in fraud since January 2025, including billions found in Medicare, and is holding criminals accountable for defrauding taxpayers.
  • In August 2025, President Trump launched the “America by Design” initiative and established the National Design Studio to enhance the usability and aesthetics of Federal digital and physical services.
    • The National Design Studio has helped government agencies and programs, such as TrumpRx, Trump Accounts, and the Federal Employees Retirement System, modernize their websites to improve Americans’ experiences with the Federal government.
  • In February 2026, President Trump launched TrumpRx.gov, where American patients can access large discounts on many of the most popular and highest-priced medicines in the country, paying prices in line with the MFN price.  TrumpRx has saved American patients more than $700 million on medicines, including massive discounts on popular medications used to treat obesity and infertility.
  • In September 2026, President Trump announced the Working Families Obamacare Refunds, returning $500 to nearly 1 million Americans from Biden Administration Obamacare overcharges. This action lowers healthcare costs for Americans and gives the money to the people, not big insurance companies.

President Donald J. Trump is calling on Congress to pass the Protect College Sports Act and bring clarity, stability, and accountability back to college athletics.

Just this weekend, President Trump was at Neyland Stadium for the blockbuster Texas–Tennessee college football game where the crowd erupted in celebration of his attendance. President Trump has tremendous respect for the determination and strength of our great athletes and the traditions that make college sports uniquely American. That is why President Trump has been a champion for this legislation and fighting to protect this proud American institution—supporting hundreds of thousands of student-athletes.

Years of litigation and uncertainty over NIL, eligibility, transfers, and revenue sharing have created a system without clear, consistent rules. The Administration is calling on Congress to establish reasonable guardrails and clear rules and put the Protect College Sports Act on President Trump’s desk.

We cannot turn back the clock, but we can protect the future of college sports and make sure opportunities remain available to student-athletes across America.

President Trump believes wholeheartedly that college sports are worth fighting for—for the athletes, the schools, the fans, and America. Scholarships, roster spots, women’s and Olympic sports, and the traditions millions of Americans cherish are on the line.

President Trump has been leading this fight to protect college sports and America’s athletes.

  • In April, President Trump signed an additional Executive Order to restore order, fairness, and stability to college athletics. He has also brought athletes, coaches, schools, and sports leaders to the White House to address the challenges facing college sports.
  • In 2025, President Trump signed an Executive Order to protect student-athletes and collegiate athletic scholarships and opportunities, including in Olympic and non-revenue programs, and the unique American institution of college sports.
  • The Trump Administration rescinded the Biden Administration’s overly burdensome and profoundly unfair NIL guidance that treated NIL agreements between schools and students like financial aid to be distributed between male and female athletes proportionally under Title IX. 
  • President Trump signed an executive order to protect women’s sports by keeping biological men out of them.
  • President Trump convened a college sports roundtable at the White House with leading sports figures from across the sports landscape to address the future of the industry.

The greatest threat is inaction and uncertainty—Congress must act now to establish clear, fair rules for NIL and protect the future of college athletics.

Today, President Donald J. Trump announced one of the largest steel plants in American history: a $15 billion Mesabi Metallics mill in Iowa. The project will create 1,750 permanent Iowa jobs, support up to 6,000 construction jobs, and is projected to add $95 billion to the U.S. economy over the next decade.

The mill will produce 7.5 million tons of steel per year in its first phase, rising to about ten million tons, using iron ore from Mesabi Metallics’ newly opened Minnesota mine — the first new iron ore mine in the United States in 50 years.

This is the kind of project Democrats spent years making impossible. The Obama Administration blocked a proposed northern Minnesota copper-nickel mine by denying its federal lease renewals in 2016. The Biden Administration canceled those same leases in 2022, then banned mining for 20 years across 225,504 acres of the Superior National Forest. It revoked a key federal water permit for another long-stalled copper-nickel mine. It blocked a 211-mile road in Alaska that would’ve opened a major copper and cobalt district. In 2024, it piled new rules onto taconite iron-ore processing and coke ovens — the plants that feed American steel — while tariff loopholes kept foreign steel flowing in.

President Trump reversed those policies — and American mining is roaring ahead.

  • In 2025, the U.S. surpassed Japan in crude steel production for the first time since 1999 and became the world’s third-largest steel producer. In fact, raw steel output is up 9% since President Trump returned to office.
  • Nearly 6,000 steelworker jobs have been added after almost 10,000 were lost under the prior Administration.
  • American mills now supply 84% of the U.S. finished steel market, up from 77% in 2024.
  • Steel imports are falling as tariffs, permitting reforms, and energy dominance bring production home.
  • New mill orders hit a record $17.3 billion in July 2026; domestic shipments hit a record $16.9 billion that same month.
  • U.S. manufacturing has expanded for eight straight months.

For over 250 years, America’s hunters and anglers have been faithful stewards of our great outdoors—respecting the land, pursuing their sport with honor, and preserving our lands and waters.  On National Hunting and Fishing Day, we pay tribute to the American sportsmen, hunters, and fishermen who protect our abundant resources, cherish our Nation’s natural beauty, and sustain one of the oldest and proudest customs in American life.

Hunting and fishing have fed our families, tamed our frontier, and shaped the character of our people since the very beginning of our national story.  Today, American outdoorsmen are the backbone of conservation, passing their skills and respect for the land from one generation to the next.  They also support a thriving outdoor economy that sustains jobs, strengthens rural communities, and contributes billions of dollars into the wild places they love through every license, tag, and piece of gear they buy. 

My Administration has proudly carried forward this great tradition by giving Americans more access to their public lands than ever before.  During my first term, I signed the Great American Outdoors Act—the single largest investment in America’s national parks and public lands in history and the most significant conservation achievement since Teddy Roosevelt’s Presidency.  I also enacted landmark legislation protecting 1.3 million new acres of wilderness and unlocked more than 2.3 million acres for American sportsmen, and we recovered more endangered and threatened species than any prior administration in a single term.

Just this month, I was proud to sign an Executive Order to reinvigorate America’s hunting heritage, opening new hunting opportunities on federal lands—including places long cut off from sportsmen due to Federal overreach—and expanding Sunday hunting across our Nation.  This order also directs my Cabinet to work alongside the States to promote thriving populations of America’s iconic game species, and it prioritizes incentives that cultivate the hunting tradition in young Americans and veterans like never before.  In addition, I signed an Executive Order to restore American saltwater angling and recreation, slashing burdensome regulations on boaters, anglers, and outdoor businesses; modernizing catch reporting; rebuilding prized stocks like the Atlantic Striped Bass; and turning retired offshore platforms into flourishing artificial reefs. 

My Administration was also proud to reestablish the Hunting and Shooting Conservation and Access Council earlier this year, calling on distinguished sportsmen and conservation leaders from across the country to council the Federal Government on conserving our wildlife and opening more public land to hunting and shooting sports.  Through these historic initiatives, my Administration will continue to cut red tape, expand access for every American sportsman, and strengthen our great outdoor economy—restoring the integrity of our national lands and keeping their splendor intact for generations to come, guaranteeing that these wonders remain the birthright of every American, now and forever.

Today, our Nation proudly celebrates the hunters and fishermen who champion their sport and take to the field and stream—whose heritage is America’s heritage.  Together, we will preserve this cherished tradition, and as long as I am President, the best hunting and fishing will always be found here in the United States of America.

DELIVERING FOR AMERICANS: This week, President Donald J. Trump and First Lady Melania Trump hosted President Xi Jinping and Madame Peng Liyuan of the People’s Republic of China for a reciprocal State Visit. During the visit, President Trump advanced the U.S.-China relationship and put the American people first. 

  • The United States welcomed China’s scheduling of orphines, a class of deadly drugs. The United States also noted China’s new export controls on two fentanyl precursor chemicals, while strongly encouraging the permanent scheduling of these and other substances and chemicals to help stem the flow of illicit precursors to dangerous narcoterrorists in North America. 
  • In August 2026, acting on information from U.S. law enforcement, China arrested 21 Chinese citizens for the manufacture and distribution of precursor chemicals to illicit drug producers in North America. The United States strongly encouraged maximum sentences, including the death penalty where applicable.
  • President Trump urged President Xi to increase production of refined petroleum products to stabilize global supply.
  • The United States welcomes the arrival of two giant pandas, leased by China to the Atlanta Zoo.

OPERATIONALIZING THE BOARDS OF TRADE AND INVESTMENT: This week, the two leaders operationalized the cornerstone government-to-government mechanisms of the U.S.-China Board of Trade and the U.S.-China Board of Investment, which were chartered during the May 2026 Summit in Beijing. 

  • Under the Board of Trade, the two countries reached consensus on recommendations for more favorable tariff treatment for $30 billion of non-sensitive goods in each direction. The Board of Trade also launched a working group focused on addressing market access barriers in the agricultural sector. 
    • For U.S. exports, the goods include agricultural goods, fish and seafood, logs and wood products, cosmetics and medical devices. 
    • For U.S. imports, the goods include consumer products such as small appliances, toys, holiday decorations, and children’s car seats. 
  • Following President Trump’s revival of the U.S. coal industry, China will import at least 10 million metric tons of coal from the United States in 2027 and again 2028.
  • The two countries established the Board of Investment. The mission of the Board of Investment is to discuss potential investment opportunities and investment-related impediments and to provide a structured channel for the two sides to address commercially meaningful investment-related issues. 
  • The United States and China continue to work on U.S. concerns regarding supply chain shortages related to rare earths and other critical minerals, with the goal of ensuring shipment levels return to appropriate levels. 

MAKING THE WORLD SAFER FOR AMERICANS: President Trump and President Xi discussed fostering peace and prosperity to enhance confidence for businesses and consumers around the world. The two countries agreed to build a constructive relationship of strategic stability on the basis of respect, fairness, and reciprocity.

  • The two countries will support each other as respective hosts of G20 and APEC, with both leaders intending to attend each other’s Summit.
  • The two leaders discussed on-going global concerns, including Russia, North Korea, and Iran. They agreed that Iran can never have a nuclear weapon and that no country or institution can be allowed to impose tolls on international waterways. 
  • The two leaders recalled that United States and China were allies in World War II and fought side by side to win the war. 
  • Since World War II, the United States’ forward military presence has preserved a Free and Open Indo-Pacific contributing to generations of American prosperity.
  • The President advocated for trilateral arms control negotiations between the United States, Russia, and China.
  • The two leaders agreed to use the term “super intelligence” rather than “artificial intelligence” to describe the applicable emerging technologies.
  • The two countries established the U.S.-China Super Intelligence (SI) Dialogue to exchange views on risks and benefits related to SI. The next exchange will occur by November 2026. The United States and China also agreed to establish a bilateral communication channel for SI incidents.

Today, President Donald J. Trump and First Lady Melania Trump concluded a historic state visit with His Excellency Xi Jinping, President of the People’s Republic of China, and Madame Peng Liyuan. This marked the first visit to the White House by a Chinese President in more than a decade — and the first time a Chinese leader has made two formal state visits to the United States.

As President Trump said, “The meeting was one of Friendship, Strength, and Success, for both China and the U.S.A… Much has been, and will be, accomplished.”

  • President Trump and the First Lady welcomed President Xi and Madame Peng with an official state arrival ceremony: “President Xi, Madame Peng, and the members of the Chinese delegation, I am delighted to welcome you to the beautiful White House.”
  • President Trump and the First Lady hosted a full official state welcome, including a gift exchange, Silent Drill Platoon review, military review, and flyover — a commanding display of American strength and hospitality.
  • President Trump and President Xi held productive bilateral discussions: “I think our farmers are going to be very happy — a lot of very positive things happened… Great things for both countries. It’s just been very, very productive.”
  • President Trump presented President Xi and Madame Peng with a custom-made statue of a bald eagle at the state dinner: “The bald eagle is a national symbol of the United States and an embodiment of the free and soaring spirit of America — and we hope it will find a nice place, a wonderful place, in Beijing.”
  • President Trump toasted President Xi and Madame Peng at the state dinner: “May all of our people know a future of harmony, peace, and success.”
  • President Trump gave President Xi an exclusive tour of Marine One and the new South Lawn helipad: “He likes granite. He’s an expert on stone, aside from many other things, and he loves good granite.”
  • President Trump and the First Lady hosted tea for President Xi and Madame Peng: “We’ve had a tremendous visit from two spectacular people, and we really enjoyed it — and I think we’ve made tremendous strides. We’ve made great strides. Very positive for both countries.”
  • President Trump and the First Lady hosted President Xi and Madame Peng at the National Archives in recognition of the 250th anniversary of American independence.

This state visit showcased the strength of the United States, advanced American economic interests, and made one thing unmistakable: peace and prosperity are strongest when America leads from a position of power.

BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA

A PROCLAMATION

America is free, strong, secure, and prosperous due to the courage of the heroes in uniform who are willing to lay down their lives in the defense of our Republic.  The supreme sacrifice paid by every fallen warrior is borne in perpetual sorrow and profound anguish by the loved ones left behind.  On Gold Star Mother’s and Family’s Day, we pause to honor the surviving families of our valiant patriots and renew our sacred obligation to always support them.

Gold Star Families endure the unfathomable — burying their Soldier, Sailor, Marine, Airman, Guardian, or Coast Guardsman who fell protecting our birthright of freedom.  In an instant, their lives are forever changed; their future plans, hopes, and dreams are replaced by a folded flag, medals, awards, precious pictures, and cherished memories.  In spite of incalculable loss, many bereaved often turn their grief into resolve, selflessly devoting themselves to service and outreach efforts in aid of those who have lost a family member in the Armed Forces.  In communities nationwide, they support military members, families, and veterans and bring hope and healing to other shattered souls.  Each act of kindness and compassion honors the memory of their beloved and is a testament to the uncommon resilience and grace of those from whom so much has been taken.

As President, I will always ensure that our Gold Star spouses and families have the support they deserve to carry forward with strength and to preserve their loved ones’ legacies.  To that end, I was proud to recently establish the first-ever Military Spouse Commission, whose members — the spouses of our Nation’s highest-ranking military leaders and officials — bring more than 544 years of combined military family experience and a deep understanding of the sacrifices made on the home front.  As part of this important work, they are finding solutions to the challenges facing military families, including strengthening deployment-readiness.  Furthermore, the Commission members are standing with our Gold Star Mothers and Families, as well as working with the Department of War’s Gold Star Advisory Council.  Under my leadership, our Nation will always support those who have stood beside our fallen warriors — patriots who kept their oath to our Republic to the very end — and together, we will keep faith with their families and forever honor their sacrifices.

Today, the First Lady joins me in prayer, sympathy, and gratitude for every American whose loved one gave the last full measure of devotion.  As Commander in Chief, I pledge to do everything in my power to love and support them and to valiantly safeguard the blessed freedom their spouses, children, and parents died to defend.

The Congress, by Senate Joint Resolution 115 of June 23, 1936 (49 Stat. 1895 as amended), has designated the last Sunday in September as “Gold Star Mother’s Day.”

NOW, THEREFORE, I, DONALD J. TRUMP, President of the United States of America, by virtue of the authority vested in me by the Constitution and the laws of the United States, do hereby proclaim Sunday, September 27, 2026, as Gold Star Mother’s and Family’s Day.  I call upon all Government officials to display the flag of the United States over Government buildings, and I encourage the American people to display the flag and hold appropriate ceremonies as an expression of our Nation’s gratitude and respect.

     IN WITNESS WHEREOF, I have hereunto set my hand this twenty-fifth day of September, in the year of our Lord two thousand twenty-six, and of the Independence of the United States of America the two hundred and fifty-first.

                            

DONALD J. TRUMP

The attacks on President Donald J. Trump’s public service announcements are highly dishonest. The announcements are very clearly not campaign ads; President Trump is not on the ballot and there is no call to action. Instead, the announcements are a reminder for Americans to love their country and know why it’s worth defending — at home, at the border, and abroad.

That’s not partisanship — that’s a government that still believes in the country it serves.

Administrations of both parties have used public service announcements to explain policy and make the case for the nation’s direction:

  • The G.W. Bush Administration ran a national television campaign explaining the Medicare Prescription Drug, Improvement, and Modernization Act to seniors. It also bought Super Bowl airtime for anti-drug and anti-terrorism public service announcements.
  • The Obama Administration used national advertising to promote Obamacare subsidies and open enrollment, and a digital campaign to sell its Waters of the United States rule.
  • The Biden Administration poured hundreds of millions of dollars into “We Can Do This” — television, digital, radio, and print spots — to drive a nationwide public health message.
  • It’s not just modern Administrations. President Woodrow Wilson’s Committee on Public Information used posters, films, and speakers to rally the country. President Franklin D. Roosevelt’s Office of War Information produced films, radio, and posters to promote the war effort.

When prior Administrations utilized the airwaves, it was called “public education.” When this Administration promotes pride in our country, many of those same voices call it “propaganda.”

Patriotism isn’t partisan. These public service announcements are unapologetically American, clearly disclosed, and aimed at the country — not a line on the ballot.
